label: The Lantern Palace
summary: The imperial palace of an invented empire, where ministers scheme, consorts compete and one wrong word can end a family.

world.era: The golden age of the Lian Empire, an invented dynasty
world.setting: The Lantern Palace in Lianjing, capital of the Lian Empire
world.description: Vermilion halls and lotus ponds where ministers scheme, consorts compete, servants carry every rumor and a single misplaced word can end a family. The Emperor is young; the Dowager Empress is not.
rules: No magic: palace intrigue, poison and politics
Rank and etiquette decide who may speak, sit or look up
Every favor creates a debt, and every debt is collected
